description:
The CNPJs you watch, with the applied quota (free + purchased slots).
The origin (`api.radar-cnpj.com`) checks the quota, inside the transaction; the app counts one free slot plus the purchased slots in force. A watch over the quota comes with `suspensa: true` and sends no e-mail.
